cohort: All single deliveries between January 2011 and December 2012 at the Division of Perinatal Medicine, Policlinico Abano Terme.
finding: The 'two-step' delivery approach did not increase the risk of PPH compared to operative delivery, elective cesarean section, and emergency cesarean section.
mod_finding: The 'two-step' delivery approach did not increase the risk of PPH compared to operative delivery, elective cesarean section, and emergency cesarean section.
